text.text_excerpt: This place is the shiz. I love that sugar park is back, after quite a long hiatus. They offer dining in as well as carryout and delivery. Their menu online is exactly what I had in my hand when I went in, which is nice and kinda rare in this town. I have been 3 times now, and still get the same damn thing because it's become a craving. The spicy marinara, veggie "meatballs" with spaghetti. I skip the garlic bread that comes with it, but my guests usually eat it. The service is awesome, friendly, and not too intrusive. You can BYOB with no corkage fee, which is sweet. We went to the mart a little up St. Claude, but it's sketchy in there. Definitely excited to try their other veg options. M...

I don't go here for the pizza. It's not bad but it's not my favorite style of pie. HOWEVER! Damn near everything else on the menu is pretty righteous. The fish n chips are up there with the best I have ever had and they are served with some extremely fresh and extremely tasty tartar sauce. The burgers are juicy and huge, the husband always gets their nice thick sliced smokey bacon on top. Its unbelievable how hard it is to find good bacon in this town, Sugar Park, y'all got it right! The salads and pasta dishes are pretty good and please don't pass up dessert. As a nice little bonus the courtyard out back is cozy and cute, staff is great, bathrooms are pristine, inside dining room is dark...

As a transplanted New Yorker, the pizza situation in New Orleans has nearly brought me to tears on more than one occasion. Yes, I'm fully aware of the existence of Pizza Delicious, and I'm sure it is as good as everyone says, but there's just no way I'm going to plan my Sunday around making a phone call for a pizza that I'm going to have to wait hours to eat. No way. When I want pizza, I want pizza. And ooooooh! What a pizza! Thin and crispy crust! Zesty sauce! Just the right amount of cheese! Sure, it's a little greasy: IT'S PIZZA! Don't restrict yourself to just pizza, either! I know, it's hard: you want pizza, they have excellent pizza, so why not just eat the pizza? I'll tell you why:...
